title: "UnSafeAFK"
body:
This is a safe AFK mod for players of "Survival Redstone Server".  
When the player is in danger, send a specified message to the server to trigger a specified function.  
(Helps you stay safer when using redstone machinery with TNT)  
Use /safeafk to configure related content  

Triggered when health is below the safe threshold  
Triggered when a fatal TNT explosion occurs within 0.5 seconds  
Display TNT within a 10-meter radius on the HUD  
tnt name displays relevant information  
Automatic login related functions  

English/Simplified Chinese support
